pages.raw_meta: At Hagerty, we are guided by our purpose to save driving and car culture for future generations. Learn more.
raw_blocks: Hagerty was built by drivers, for drivers.

At Hagerty, we’re here to make it easier and more enjoyable for you to be a driving enthusiast with unique insurance products, live and digital marketplaces, events, publishing and enthusiast content.
A world where loved cars are driven, shared and enjoyed.
Make it easier and more enjoyable to be a driving enthusiast.
We’re the world’s largest community of driving enthusiasts, the Hagerty Drivers Club.
Broad Arrow Auctions, Private Sales and Capital
We believe automotive heritage is worth saving and celebrating
We operate with integrity & excellence

Treating our team members, members, and shareholders with the highest degree of integrity is core to our mission. Our members trust us to be honest and deliver on our promise to provide better coverage at lower prices for the cars they love – so they can focus on the joy of driving. By representing our products and services with integrity and committing to exceeding our members’ expectations, we earn exceptional customer loyalty and enable our business to thrive and grow.

Hagerty has a long-standing commitment to customer privacy and data security . We protect our team members’ and members’ personal data from unauthorized third-party access, malicious attacks, and data exploitation, and follow strict data protection requirements.

At Hagerty, we are fueling business growth and impact through strong leadership and best-in-class governance, ensured by our experienced Management and Board of Directors . Our Board is comprised of individuals with diverse and strategically relevant experiences in many disciplines that impact our business, as well as an independent lead director, and 25% female representation.
We rely on our integrity to do what is right and that includes speaking up when we witness or know of any violations of our Code of Conduct or other Hagerty policies.

We encourage our team members to report concerns to their supervisor, to Human Resources or Legal and Compliance departments. Through the Hagerty We Listen reporting system we empower everyone at Hagerty to report concerns about potential compliance violations or unethical business practices.

We review all Code, handbook, or policy violations that are reported and take necessary steps to address the matters. Retaliation against anyone who raises a concern in good faith is strictly prohibited.
We strive to make a positive impact in the world.

pages.raw_meta: Explore Hagerty’s specialty insurance offerings — including event, personal umbrella, and more — powered by our trusted partners and expertise.
raw_blocks: Hagerty offers exceptional insurance for classic and collector vehicles—driven by a deep passion for the road and decades of expertise. Through trusted partnerships, we also provide a range of coverage options to help protect more of what matters, all in one convenient place.
Hagerty offers specialized business coverage to help keep you and the cars in your care protected.
Event Insurance is affordable, quick to issue and may offer protection against event cancellation, unforeseen accidents, and other event-specific liabilities.
High Performance Drivers Education (HPDE) & Time Trial
Track day insurance — on the track and in the paddock - Hagerty covers all your high-performance driving needs.
Marine Business Insurance protects against the unique risks found in the marine industry. Work worry free with this essential coverage through Hagerty.
Whether you’re transporting your collector car by sea or air, make sure you’re covered with international shipping coverage through Hagerty.
A personal umbrella policy is a low-cost, extra layer of protection that increases the basic coverage provided by your auto, home, marine or other personal insurance.
Missing titles or dealer licensing requirements? With our trusted partners, you can quickly secure the bond you need to keep your classic or collector vehicle on the road.

Policies underwritten by Markel Insurance Company, Markel American Insurance Company or Travelers Insurance Company. Hagerty determines final risk acceptance. Some coverage not available in all states. This is a general description of coverage. All coverage is subject to policy provisions, exclusions and endorsements.
